description: Creates a new company asset with the provided details

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Locale for localized response messages (for example: en, fr-FR, pseudo)

201.description: Asset created successfully. When conditional WARNING rules apply, the body is AssetUpdateWarningResponse with conditional_warnings; otherwise SingleAssetResponse.

400.description: The server could not understand the request due to invalid syntax or parameters that fail to meet validation requirements.

401.description: Although the HTTP standard specifies "unauthorized", semantically this response means "unauthenticated". That is, the client must authenticate itself to get the requested response.

403.description: The client does not have access rights to the content; that is, it is authenticated, but the server is refusing to give the requested resource. Unlike 401, the client's identity is known to the server.

404.description: The server can not find the requested resource. This can mean either the URL is not recognized, or the resource itself does not exist. Servers may also send this response instead of 403 to hide the existence of a resource from an unauthorized client.

422.description: The request was well-formed but was unable to be followed due to semantic errors.

schema.description: Asset creation request. Note: Required fields may vary based on fieldset configuration. Refer to the Fieldset API to determine which fields are required for your asset type.

asset_type_id.description: Asset type ID (primary key of the asset type). Must have Is Asset enabled for that type.

asset_code.description: Unique identifier for the asset (also referred to as asset_code in API). Must be unique at company level (case-insensitive). Optional when an active naming rule exists—the ID (code) will be auto-ge...

location_id.description: Location ID where the asset is located (only applicable for project asset)

trade_id.description: Trade ID associated with the asset

latitude.description: Latitude must be provided together with longitude, or both must be omitted.(only applicable for project asset)

longitude.description: Longitude must be provided together with latitude, or both must be omitted.(only applicable for project asset)

parent_asset_id.description: Parent asset ID. Optional. When provided, creates a parent-child relationship. The parent must exist, belong to the same company, and be in the same asset type hierarchy.
